units.source_text: 昭和十三年六月二十六日，绵绵的梅雨天开始放晴。

en.t: On June 26, Showa 13, the long spell of rainy-season weather began to clear.

units.source_text: 天空飘浮着淡淡的夏云。

en.t: Faint summer clouds drifted across the sky.

units.source_text: 芝公园红叶馆的庭院里，苍松翠竹被雨水冲刷一新，稀疏的竹叶上闪烁着强烈的阳光。

en.t: In the garden of the Momijikan at Shiba Park, the dark pines and green bamboo had been washed fresh by the rain, and strong sunlight glittered on the sparse bamboo leaves.
